maddeler.e:
أحتفر (form VIII)
# أَحْتَفِرُ (ʔaḥtafiru) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# أُحْتَفَرُ (ʔuḥtafaru) /ʔuħ.ta.fa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# أَحْتَفِرَ (ʔaḥtafira) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# أُحْتَفَرَ (ʔuḥtafara) /ʔuħ.ta.fa
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
